tei:div.tei:p: 349) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: dbang chen pad+ma drag po'i gtor bzlog bsdus pa bzhugs so: 350) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

gu ru he ru ka la 'dud: phyi rabs skal ldan don ched du: phrin las drag sgrub las kyi mtha': gtor bzlog zab mo 'di ru bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: de nas bca' gzhi'i rim pa ni: lcags snod nang du gtor ma ni: lha grangs dang bstun rim par bkod: mtha' mar mtshe yungs rtsang dang ni: sha khrag ling ga dag gis brgyan: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: drag shul rngams pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: hūm̐ bh+yo: dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: bcom ldan pad+ma dbang chen he ru ka: drag khros rngams pa log 'dren bgegs kyi bshed: 351)dmar gsal khro gtum rngams brjid gzi 'od 'bar: gnyis med bde sbyor khro mo yum dang bcas: chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos skur bzhengs la: log 'dren dgra bgegs bzlog bsgyur dus la babs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dug gsum nyon 'khrul dgra dang bgegs dpung bzlog: ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i 'khor lo shig: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams thams cad bzlog: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rigs thams cad bzlog: ye 'grogs sum brgya drug cu'i gnod pa bzlog: glo bur dgu bcu 352)rtsa gcig gnod pa bzlog: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad bzlog: phur zor rbod gtong ngan sngags gtad khram bzlog: lha srin sde brgyad rgol ba thams cad bzlog: dus kyi g.yo 'khrugs 'byung bzhi'i yo log bzlog: mi mthun chags che nyam nga thams cad bzlog: bzlog go bstan dgra dam nyams steng du bzlog: bsgyur ro gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du bsgyur: e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog sa ma ya: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ shar phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: dbang chen sku yi sprul pa'i sras 'khor bcas: me long ye shes ngang las skur bzhengs la: log 'dren dgra bgegs bzlog bsgyur dus la babs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:

zhe sdang g.yo 'khrugs dgra dang bgegs dpung bzlog: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad= sogs nas: bsgyur ro gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du bsgyuraḥ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ lho phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: dpal chen yon tan sprul pa'i lha tshogs rnams: mnyam nyid ye shes ngang= log 'dren dgra bgegs= sha khrag dmar gyi= nga rgyal 353)g.yo 'khrugs dgra gdon bgegs tshogs bzlog: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i= sogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: nub phyogs 'khor lo 'bar= dbang chen gsung gi sprul pa'i sras 'khor bcas: sor rtogs ye shes ngang las skur bzhengs la: log 'dren dgra bgegs bzlog bsgyur dus la babs: sha khrag dmar gyi= 'dod chags g.yo 'khrugs dgra gdon bgegs tshogs bzlog: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i= sogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: byang phyogs 'khor lor 'bar= dbang chen phrin las sprul pa'i sras 'khor bcas: bya grub ye shes dbyings las skur bzhengs la: log 'dren dgra bgegs bzlog bsgyur dus la babs: sha khrag dmar gyi= phrag dog g.yo 'khrugs dgra gdon bgegs tshogs bzlog: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i= sogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas: dbang chen sprul pa'i khro bcu yum dang bcas: ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar bsgyur la: log 'dren dgra bgegs bzlog bsgyur dus la babs: sha khrag dmar gyi= phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs g.yul ngo dgra la bzlog: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i= sogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: dbang chen 354)sprul pa'i bka' nyan las byed tshogs: ging dang pho nya sgo skyong srung ma sogs: phrin las bzhi sgrub dngos grub kun gyi bdag: dam tshig thugs dam dbang gis skur bzhengs la: log 'dren dgra bgegs bzlog bsgyur dus la babs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di shes la: bstan pa'i ru tra bdud bgegs log 'dren tshogs: gtan nas brlags bsgral drag po'i phrin las kyis: rjes shul lhag med rdul phran phye mar rlogs:

dus 'khrugs nad mtshon mi mthun phyogs ngan bzlog: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i= sogasaḥ e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog sa ma ya: de ltar gtor bzlog zab mo 'dir brtson pas: mi mthun 'gal rkyen thams cad ngang gis zhi: drag po'i phrin las mtha' ru phyin par nges: rjes rim gtor ma zor du 'phangs pa yis: gzugs can gzugs med bstan dgra rdul brlag na: don gnyis mdzad pa phrin las 'byung bar 'gyur: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di'ang nye gnas dge btsun shī la badz+ra dang bya bral shes rab 'od zer sogs kyis yang yang nan cher bskul ngor zob brdzun bde ba'i rdo rjes nyams chos yig ris su bgyis pa'o//
